name: @unbrowse/cross-fetch-shim
description: Drop-in replacement for cross-fetch. Keeps the universal fetch ponyfill surface (default fetch + named fetch/Headers/Request/Response) but routes a safe GET through Unbrowse's resolved-route cache ($0 on hit), falling through to native fetch on miss — identical semantics.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm
